result.topic_en: Second part of Riemann's Paris prize essay draft: conditions under which a quadratic differential form $\sum b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ can be transformed into a form with constant coefficients (equivalently $\sum dx^2$), deriving the curvature-type equations via second derivatives of the transformation.
result.transcription:
Pars secunda.
De transformatione expressionis $\sum_{1}^{n}\sum_{1}^{n} {}^{\iota\,\iota'}(b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'})$
in formam datam $\sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$
Quum quaestio ab Ill$^{ma}$ Academia ad corpora homogenea restricta sit, in quibus conductibilitates resultantes sint [-...-] constantes,
evolvamus primum conditiones, ut expressio $\sum_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ {+aequando quantitates s functionibus ipsarum x,+} in formam $\sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$ constantibus coefficientibus $a_{\iota\iota'}$ affectam transformari possit. Deinde [-transformationis-] {+de transformatione+} [-theoriam transformationis de-] in formam quamlibet datam [-obiter-] [-addiiciamus-] {+pauca+} [-pauca-] pauca adjiciemus.
[-Expressio-] {+Forma+} $\sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$ [-constantibus coefficientibus-] {+constantibus+} affectam, si est, id quod supponimus, forma positiva ipsarum $dx$, semper in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ redigi posse constat. [-Quaeramus igitur, quando in-]
Unde si $\sum_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ in formam $\sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$ [-...-] transformari potest, redigi etiam potest in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ & viceversa. Quaeramus igitur, quando in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ [-redigi-] transformari [-possit-].
[-Si $\sum \beta_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$-] Sit determinans $\sum \pm b_{1,1}\, b_{2,2} \cdots b_{n,n} = B$ et determinantes partiales $= \beta_{\iota\iota'}$, quo pacto erit $\sum_\iota \beta_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} = B$
& $\sum_\iota \beta_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota''} = 0$, si $\iota' \gtrless \iota''$.
Si $\sum b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'} = \sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ pro valoribus quibuslibet ipsarum $dx$, [-etiam ponendo-] {+substituendo+} $d+\delta$ [-pro-] d invenitur,
etiam $\sum b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota \delta s_{\iota'} = \sum_\iota dx_\iota \delta x_\iota$ pro valoribus quibuslibet ipsarum $dx$ & $\delta x$. Hinc si quantitates $ds_\iota$ per $dx_\iota$ et quantitates $\delta x_\iota$ per quantitates $\delta s_\iota$ exprimantur sequitur esse
(1) $\frac{\partial x_{\nu'}}{\partial s_\nu} = \sum_\iota b_{\nu\iota} \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_{\nu'}}$
et proinde
(2) $\frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_{\nu'}} = \sum_\nu \frac{\beta_{\nu\iota}}{B} \frac{\partial x_{\nu'}}{\partial s_\nu}$
Unde porro deducitur, quum sit $\sum_\nu \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_\nu}\frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_\iota} = 1$ & $\sum \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_\nu}\frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_{\iota'}} = 0$ si $\iota \lessgtr \iota'$
(3) $\sum_\nu \frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_\iota}\frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_{\iota'}} = b_{\iota\iota'}$ (4) $\sum \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x}\frac{\partial s_{\iota'}}{\partial x} = \frac{\beta_{\iota\iota'}}{B}$
et differentiando formulam posteriorem [?]
$\sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_\iota \partial s_{\iota''}}\frac{\partial x}{\partial s_{\iota'}} + \sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_{\iota'}\partial s_{\iota''}}\frac{\partial x}{\partial s_\iota} = \frac{\partial b_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial s_{\iota''}}$
Jam ex [-valoribus-] his ipsarum $\frac{\partial b_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial s_{\iota''}}, \frac{\partial b_{\iota\iota''}}{\partial s_{\iota'}}, \frac{\partial b_{\iota'\iota''}}{\partial s_\iota}$ {+expressionibus+} [-valoribus-] eruitur
(5) $2\sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_{\iota'}\partial s_{\iota''}}\frac{\partial x}{\partial s_\iota} = \frac{\partial b_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial s_{\iota''}} + \frac{\partial b_{\iota\iota''}}{\partial s_{\iota'}} - \frac{\partial b_{\iota'\iota''}}{\partial s_\iota}$
et si haec quantitas per $p_{\iota,\iota'\iota''}$ designatur
(6) $2\frac{\partial^2 x_\nu}{\partial s_{\iota'}\partial s_{\iota''}} = \sum_\iota \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_\nu} p_{\iota,\iota'\iota''}$.
[-Obtinetur-] Quantitatibus $p_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$ iterum differentiatis obtinetur
$\frac{\partial p_{\iota,\iota'\iota''}}{\partial s_{\iota'''}} - \frac{\partial p_{\iota,\iota'\iota'''}}{\partial s_{\iota''}} = 2\sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_\iota \partial s_{\iota'''}}\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_{\iota'}\partial s_{\iota''}} - 2\sum \frac{\partial x}{\partial s_\iota \partial s_{\iota''}}\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_{\iota'}\partial s_{\iota'''}}$
unde tandem prodit, substitutis valoribus modo inventis e (6) & (4)
(I) $2\left(\frac{\partial^2 b_{\iota\iota''}}{\partial s_{\iota'}\partial s_{\iota''}} + \frac{\partial^2 b_{\iota'\iota''}}{\partial s_\iota \partial s_{\iota''}} - \qquad\right) + \qquad = 0$
Hujusmodi igitur aequationibus [-...-] functiones b satisfaciant necesse est, quando $\sum_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ transformari potest; partes laevas harum aequationum [-designabimus-] designabimus per
$(\iota\iota', \iota''\iota''')$.
Ut indoles harum aequationum melius perspiciatur, formetur expressio
